---
title: "About Me"
---

I am a Master's student in Applied Economics and Data Science at the University of Pennsylvania. I received my B.S. in Accounting, Finance, and Economics from The Pennsylvania State University.

My research interests include applied economics, econometrics, industrial organization, price measurement, and consumer behavior. I am particularly interested in using large-scale datasets and quantitative methods to study empirical economic questions.
